{{Top|leg}}
'''Bluefruit jam''' was a type of jam made from [[bluefruit]], a fruit from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It tasted good on its own, but when mixed with the taste of [[saltnut butter]], it was said to be able to induce a [[Sand cat/Legends|sand cat]] to gag.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

The jam was a second favorite of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jos Vondar]], after saltnut butter.<ref name="MedStar II" />
